# Tvine

> Tvine is an agent-native, full-stack TypeScript web framework (Warp backend: models, ORM,
> migrations, auth, admin, middleware, tasks, bot protection) plus Next.js pages (Weft UI) in one process. Every backend
> action is at once a typed `api.*` call, an HTTP endpoint and an MCP tool, so AI agents can read and drive the app.
> npm package `tvinejs`; code imports `tvine` and the CLI runs as `tvine` (`npx tvinejs startproject mysite`, then `pnpm tvine dev`).

Inside a Tvine project the same files ship in the package: `node_modules/tvine/llms-full.txt` and `node_modules/tvine/docs/<topic>.md`.

## Using any Tvine site as an agent (in order)

1. `GET /llms.txt`: what the site is and how to talk to it. Every page links it (`Link: </llms.txt>; rel="describedby"`), and so does the Shield challenge page ("Are you an AI agent?" note + `<script type="application/json" id="tvine-agent">`).
2. `GET /.well-known/mcp.json` (MCP server card: endpoint, transport, tools) and `/.well-known/tvine.json` (formats, header names).
3. Connect MCP at `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) → `tools/list` → `read_page` (view "md" is the best first read) → `ui` / `do` with the control ids it shows.
4. No MCP client: plain HTTP on the page URL with `Accept: text/markdown` or `x-tvine: 1`; keep the session with `x-tvine-sid` (from the first line `#tvine/1 sid=…`).
5. All actions and their params: `GET /tvine/manifest`.
6. Need the person's real logged-in browser: `request_control` → they click Allow in their tab → you drive it with a visible cursor; `release` or their Stop ends it.
7. Refusals are JSON with a `hint` (`challenge_required`, `blocked`, `rate_limited`); send an honest User-Agent (`Claude-User`, `ChatGPT-User`, `Grok/1.0`). Headers reference: agents-and-mcp.md → "HTTP headers".

## Start here (building a Tvine app)

- [AGENTS.md (AI guide)](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/packages/tvine/AGENTS.md): layout, commands, recipes and rules for building a Tvine project; also written into every new project
- [Full docs in one file](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/llms-full.txt): the AI guide plus every guide below, concatenated
- [README](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/README.md): what Tvine is, feature map, screenshots

## Guides

- [installation.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/installation.md): Install, `startproject`, getting the `tvine` command
- [getting-started.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Tutorial: a notes app in 15 minutes
- [settings-and-env.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/settings-and-env.md): `settings.ts` keys, middleware catalog, logging, environment variables, `.env`
- [models-and-orm.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/models-and-orm.md): Models, fields (encrypted, humanOnly), QuerySets, await-or-not, migrations, fixtures
- [views-urls-api.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/views-urls-api.md): Actions, generic views, routers, `urls.ts`, the typed `api.*` client
- [frontend-weft.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/frontend-weft.md): Weft widgets, forms and input kinds, `HumanOnly`, confirm prompts
- [agents-and-mcp.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/agents-and-mcp.md): MCP setup (Claude Code, Claude Desktop), tools, `read_page` / `ui` / `do`, tab control and Allow, WebMCP, the inspector
- [admin.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/admin.md): Admin panel: ModelAdmin options, widgets, dashboard, charts, system pages
- [auth-and-security.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/auth-and-security.md): Users, 2FA, tokens, sessions, permissions, ALLOWED_HOSTS, CSP/CORS, audit, privacy, encryption keys
- [shield.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/shield.md): Bot protection: rules, challenges, code rules, country rules, the /shield panel, rate limits
- [tasks-cache-email.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/tasks-cache-email.md): Background tasks, cron, cache, email
- [testing.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/testing.md): Test client and helpers
- [cli.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/cli.md): Every `tvine` command
- [deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md): Production checklist, proxies, Redis, Docker
